Rede's fifth beta makes installing an update yourself clearer.

### Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.5-macos-universal.dmg` (or `.zip`) | macOS 11 or later, Apple silicon and Intel |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.5-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Linux on Intel/AMD, glibc 2.39 or newer |
| `Rede-0.1.0-beta.5-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Linux on ARM64, glibc 2.39 or newer |

The `.minisig` files are signatures Rede checks before installing an update. [Install and sign-in instructions](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/blob/rede-v0.1.0-beta.5/docs/rede/README.md).

### What's new

- A newer version in Settings › About now offers **Install**, which downloads and installs it inside Rede, and **Get from GitHub**, which opens its release page. Before, the button opened GitHub even when Rede could install the update itself.
- A copy that can't install itself, such as one run from the dmg, offers only Get from GitHub and says why.

### Please report

If an update doesn't install, Settings › About says why. Please report it with your OS, how you installed Rede, and that message.

The beta limits are the same as [0.1.0-beta.3](https://github.com/Solidsilver/ond/releases/tag/rede-v0.1.0-beta.3)'s.
